name: TableHeader

props.name: colSpan
props.description: Specify `colSpan` as a non-negative integer value to indicate how many columns the TableHeader cell extends in a table

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `TableDecoratorRow` component

props.name: isSortHeader
props.description: Specify whether this header is the header by which a table is being sorted by

props.name: isSortable
props.description: Specify whether this header is one through which a user can sort the table

props.name: scope
props.description: Specify the scope of this table header. You can find more info about this attribute at the following URL: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/th#attr-scope

props.name: slug
props.description: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `TableSlugRow` component

props.name: sortDirection
props.description: Specify which direction we are currently sorting by, should be one of DESC, NONE, or ASC.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TableHeader rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
